calculation.description: Cross-sectional signal measuring medium-term return minus recent return; positive values indicate recent deceleration relative to the prior medium-term trend.

validation.regime_notes: Overall 5-day IC and ICIR pass benchmark gates across 767 dates and average 12.75 instruments. Performance was strong in 2020-2022 (IC 0.0506, ICIR 0.1363), weak in 2023-2026, and negative in the latest 2026-07-16 to 2027-02-25 window (IC -0.0425, ICIR -0.1449); use with recency monitoring and library-correlation audit.
